title: $(\text{DNN})^2$: Doubly Non-Negative Relaxations for Deep Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.24743v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing linear program (LP) and semidefinite program (SDP) relaxations for rectified linear unit (ReLU) neural network (NN) verification yield overly-conservative safety guarantees due to significant relaxation gaps. While the completely positive program (CPP) formulation closes this gap, it is NP-hard to solve. Its cheapest tractable relaxation, the doubly non-negative program (DNN), retains critical constraints as an SDP, but one whose size exceeds the reach of interior-point methods at practical scale. While Burer-Monteiro (BM) factorization has been applied to make SDP-based verification scalable, no such result exists for the strictly tighter DNN formulation. A key obstacle is that additional non-negativity constraints in the DNN cause dual multipliers for optimality certification to be non-unique, making standard certification methods inapplicable. translated_title: $(\text{DNN})^2$: 深度神经网络的加倍非负松弛方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24743v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：现有的用于整流线性单元（ReLU）神经网络（NN）验证的线性规划（LP）和半定规划（SDP）松弛方法，由于显著的松弛间隙，会产生过于保守的安全保证。虽然完全正规划（CPP）公式可以消除这一间隙，但求解它是NP困难的。其最便宜的易处理松弛方法，即加倍非负规划（DNN），保留了作为SDP的关键约束，但其规模超出了内点法在实际应用中的处理能力。虽然Burer-Monteiro（BM）分解已被应用于使基于SDP的验证可扩展，但对于更严格的DNN公式，尚无此类结果。一个关键障碍是，DNN中额外的非负性约束导致用于最优性认证的对偶乘数不唯一，使得标准认证方法无法适用。我们提出了一种新颖的特征值最大化程序，用于搜索不唯一的乘数。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对深度神经网络验证中加倍非负规划松弛的可扩展方法，通过特征值最大化程序解决对偶乘数不唯一性问题，从而在保持严格性的同时实现高效认证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a scalable method for doubly non-negative program relaxations in deep neural network verification, addressing non-unique dual multipliers via an eigenvalue maximization procedure to achieve strictness and efficiency.
